strategy.name: Wyckoff Spring & Upthrust (UTAD)
strategy.summary: After a long range following a trend, buy the failed breakdown (spring) or its low-volume test; mirror for upthrusts.

rules.text: A horizontal range of at least 30 candles after an extended trend.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the range at least 30 candles?

rules.text: Spring: break below support, then a close back inside on a high-volume bullish reversal bar.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did price close back inside after the break?

rules.text: Safer: low-volume pullback to the spring level after a sign of strength → long on the first bullish turn.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the test on declining volume?

rules.text: Stop 0.5 × ATR below the spring low (above the UTAD high).
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop 0.5 × ATR beyond the spring?

rules.text: TP1 range top; TP2 the range height projected from the breakout.
rules.checklistQuestion: Were the targets the range top and projection?

rules.text: If candles keep closing below support it is a breakdown, not a spring — no buying.
rules.checklistQuestion: Did you avoid buying a true breakdown?
